headline: Bitcoin slides below $80k, testing $79.2k support amid liquidity hunt
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC formed a descending channel, retesting the 79.2k support zone while the 4H structure holds above the 78.8k swing low, indicating a short‑term liquidity grab.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑beta alts, with MARSCOIN, DASH and SNXXB leading gains, reflecting risk‑on sentiment after BTC’s pullback.
strategy_outlook: Spot traders may consider buying near 79.2k with a tight stop below 78.8k; futures shorts can target 80k with a trailing stop to capture the downside.
